title:
Epic to select all sensors in `Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid` or
`Reliability.AssetDataPrepExcludedSensorGrid`
when users click `Select All n Items`.

The payload of the action is expected to contain the following fields:
- `componentId`: The id of the grid that needs to be updated in case of `Select All n Items`.
name: AssetDataPrepSelectAllSensorsEpic
